Transaction execution context, account access helpers, and instruction trace management.

# Purpose
This header defines the transaction execution context used by the runtime to process a transaction. It declares `fd_exec_txn_ctx_t`, which stores transaction state, account lists, instruction trace data, compute budget details, return data, logs, and error status for execution. The file also declares helper functions to create, join, reset, and destroy the context, plus account lookup and account condition checks such as [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_at_index`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_at_index>), [`fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_with_key`](<#fd_exec_txn_ctx_get_account_with_key>), and [`fd_txn_account_check_is_writable`](<#fd_txn_account_check_is_writable>). In addition, it defines constants and macros for instruction trace limits and error handling, including `FD_TXN_ERR_FOR_LOG_INSTR` and the instruction trace entry type `fd_exec_instr_trace_entry_t`.
